title: Sir Gawain, Lines 136–159
subtitle: The Green Knight enters Arthur's hall.
objectives: Read and translate authentic Middle English texts.

sections.heading: Content
sections.body: Ther hales in at the halle dor an aghlich mayster... — 'There hastens in at the hall door a terrible master.' Vocabulary: aghlich (terrible), mayster (master), enker (warrior), grene (green), semblaunt (appearance). The Green Knight's entrance.

items.prompt: What is the focus of this lesson?
Can you apply this to reading?
items.answer: Work through examples with your notes.
